changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO strategy_defaults (strategy_id, transaction_type, lot_quantity, max_loss, no_of_trades, no_of_parallel_trades, auto_config_enabled, opposite_side, target_mode, sl_mode, trail_atr_multiple, max_volume_surge, min_candle_close_position, min_days_to_expiry) SELECT 10, s.transaction_type, s.lot_quantity, s.max_loss, s.no_of_trades, s.no_of_parallel_trades, s.auto_config_enabled, FALSE, s.target_mode, s.sl_mode, s.trail_atr_multiple, 2.00, 0.350, NULL FROM strategy_defaults s WHERE s.strategy_id = 9 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM strategy_defaults x WHERE x.strategy_id = 10)
